jobs.title: Primary Spanish Editor
jobs.reason: This role requires native-level Spanish (editing Spanish-language educational textbooks with mastery of Spanish grammar and ortho-typographic norms), which the candidate does not have — a hard language disqualifier. It also requires three years of textbook editing experience, exceeding the candidate's RA-level background, and sits entirely outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for expert advisory-committee members, not a paid staff role — it seeks established experts with regional activist/practitioner experience and reads as an unpaid/speculative advisory position rather than a genuine entry-level paid vacancy. The human-rights/securitisation topic is interesting, but the committee is aimed at senior experts, not an early-career candidate.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Enterprise Applications
jobs.reason: A "Manager"-level role requiring 3–6 years of demonstrable technical project-management experience and Scrum Master / ServiceNow / enterprise-integration expertise the candidate does not have — both a level and a deep-technical disqualifier. Although a London option exists, the essential experience and technical requirements are far beyond an early-career research profile.

jobs.title: Research Analyst - Research and Innovation Ecosystems
jobs.reason: On-level for a postgraduate with strong research and writing, which the candidate has, though the posting leans on "work experience beyond university" and a "proven track record delivering projects" that the candidate meets only partly through RA work. The topic — research and innovation policy, metascience and higher-education systems — aligns closely with the candidate's HRK/higher-education background, but it sits outside the core international-law and security interest zones, holding interest moderate. English fluency is essential and other languages only an asset, so no language gate applies.

jobs.title: Journals and Digital Content Coordinator
jobs.reason: An entry-level coordinator role at a leading global affairs think tank; the candidate's academic publishing experience and research background transfer, though this is more a publications/digital-content administration post than a research role, and dedicated digital-content and publishing-workflow experience is a partial gap. ODI is a respected policy institution, giving it adjacent interest, but the coordinator function sits outside the candidate's core research and analysis mission, which holds the score in the "worth a look" band.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Officer - Sahel
jobs.reason: Excluded by the London-only location filter — the role is based in Niamey, Niger with no London or remote option. It is also a "Senior" finance role requiring finance experience the candidate lacks, so it fails on multiple counts.

jobs.title: Associate Publisher – SN Journals
jobs.reason: Requires 5–7 years of direct journal-management experience as an essential, which the candidate plainly lacks — a hard level/experience disqualifier. It is also a commercial publishing-operations role outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Research Analyst and Programme Administrator for the Defence and Military Analysis Programme
jobs.reason: The hybrid research-plus-administration profile is a strong on-level fit — the candidate's RA work, policy writing and funding-programme administration at the German Rectors' Conference map directly onto both halves of the role. IISS is a core zone (b)/(c) target and the defence/security focus aligns well with the candidate's published work on German defence policy; the security-studies angle keeps interest high.

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter - World Wide Inspections
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — it requires an essential 5–8 years of experience in talent acquisition / procurement / vendor management, and a bachelor's degree in engineering, neither of which the candidate has. It is also a recruitment/procurement function entirely outside the candidate's research, policy and geopolitical interests.

jobs.title: PhD Programme Coordinator
jobs.reason: This is an entry-to-junior professional-services administrative role, degree-level with transferable skills the candidate has (higher-education administration, funding allocation at the German Rectors' Conference, stakeholder liaison, IT/Office). However, it is a student-facing programme-administration post rather than research, so paper fit is only moderate and the "servicing committee meetings" experience is a partial gap. Higher-education administration sits outside the candidate's core interest zones, which holds the score down.
jobs.salary: £36,513 to £41,565 pa (potential to progress to £44,468), inclusive of London allowance

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.reason: This is a deep-technical, senior full-stack software-engineering role whose essential requirements — production-grade Java (Spring Boot), front-end frameworks, AWS/Kubernetes, CI/CD, secure coding — are far beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python and web-scripting familiarity. It is also explicitly senior and internal-applicants-only, so it fails on level and access as well.
jobs.salary: £53,949–£62,160 pa (potential to £69,073) inclusive of London allowance

jobs.title: Senior Procurement Manager - Print
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — it is a Senior Manager role requiring extensive print/paper procurement, category-management and supplier-management experience the candidate lacks. It is also entirely outside the candidate's research/policy interests and skill set.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established "experts" to join an advisory committee — not an entry-level paid role, and it seeks seniority and specialist regional expertise the candidate does not have; it also reads as an unpaid advisory/volunteer position. The human-rights and securitisation subject matter is genuinely on-mission, but the level and nature of the posting are hard mismatches.

jobs.title: Chargé(e) de partenariats/Partnership Officer - France (7385)
jobs.reason: The role lists "maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais" (fluent written and spoken French) as an essential criterion, which the candidate's B1 French does not meet — a hard disqualifier. It also requires established experience in French international-development/humanitarian funding mechanisms, which the candidate lacks. The partnerships/advocacy focus is also only tangential to the candidate's core interests.
jobs.type: Contract (CDD, up to 4 months maternity/parental leave cover)

jobs.title: Print Intern
jobs.reason: This is an internship, which is excluded as a matter of policy. It is also a print-production / administrative role in publishing with no connection to the candidate's research, policy or interest areas.

jobs.title: Talent Pool Project Coordinator- Contractor - London
jobs.reason: This is explicitly not an active vacancy — it is a talent-pool / "register your interest" posting with no concrete role, which is a hard disqualifier. CIR's open-source-investigations mission sits squarely in the candidate's zone (c), but the posting also requires experience on UK Gov funded projects and demonstrable grant/project-coordination experience the candidate only partly meets.

jobs.title: Operations Administrator
jobs.reason: Genuinely entry-level and eligible — the candidate meets the degree, MS Office and administrative requirements, and their funding-allocation and project-admin experience transfers. However, this is a front-facing customer-service and operations-admin role with no research, policy or analytical substance, so it sits well outside all three interest zones and offers little career-building pull toward the candidate's mission.
jobs.type: Part-time (0.8 FTE, 28 hours/week), Fixed-term to 31 July 2027

jobs.title: Assistant Policy Advisor
jobs.reason: Location fails the London-only filter — the role is tied to Brussels with no London or fully-remote-UK option stated. The policy/advocacy work would otherwise be adjacent, but the location is a hard blocker.

jobs.title: Policy Advisor
jobs.reason: Location fails the London-only filter — the role is based in Brussels with no London or fully-remote-UK option. An "Advisor" title also likely implies experience beyond entry-level, but the location alone gates it.

jobs.title: Head of Legal
jobs.reason: A "Head of Legal" role requires senior leadership and a legal qualification the candidate does not hold, both hard disqualifiers. The subject may align, but level and qualification are unmet essentials.

jobs.title: Board Members
jobs.reason: Board membership is a senior governance appointment requiring substantial experience, far beyond an entry-level candidate, and is typically not a salaried early-career role. The level is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: NL Inspection Service Delivery Manager
jobs.reason: Multiple hard disqualifiers: it is a Manager-level leadership role requiring significant TIC-industry experience and team management, it demands fluency in Dutch (candidate is A1), and it requires an engineering degree. None of these essentials are met, and the field is entirely outside the candidate's interests.

jobs.title: Lead Analyst, Technology and Geopolitics
jobs.reason: The "Lead Analyst" title plus an essential requirement of "experience managing a team" and a background in intelligence/policy analysis place this beyond entry-level, so a HARD DISQUALIFIER on seniority applies. Sibylline and tech-geopolitics risk are squarely in the candidate's zone (b)/(c) interest, but the level is a hard mismatch for someone with only RA/student-assistant experience.

jobs.title: Programme Coordinator (4263)
jobs.reason: Location is a hard filter — the role is based in Dakar, Senegal with no London or remote-UK option, so it is excluded under the London-only policy. It also requires excellent written and verbal French (only B1) and proven experience coordinating multi-year, high-value programmes, both essentials the candidate does not meet.

jobs.title: Senior Policy Analyst I
jobs.reason: A "Senior" analyst title signals a role beyond entry-level, requiring several years of relevant experience the candidate does not have. Global development policy is adjacent interest, but the level is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Policy Fellow or Senior Policy Fellow, US Development Policy Program
jobs.reason: Located in Washington DC with no London or fully-remote-UK option, failing the London-only location filter. The fellow/senior-fellow level also implies substantial experience beyond entry-level.

jobs.title: Fellow, Climate policy & development
jobs.reason: A "Fellow" position at CGD is a senior research role requiring an established track record and typically a PhD or substantial policy experience the candidate lacks. Climate and development policy also sits outside the core interest zones.

jobs.title: Finance Business Partner - UK RAI Programmes
jobs.reason: Essential requirement is a Qualified Accountant (CCAB or equivalent), which the candidate does not hold, and the role is a managerial "Business Partner" with line-management and multi-year experience requirements well beyond entry level. Neither the finance qualification nor the seniority can be met, so it is a hard mismatch despite the humanitarian organisation.

jobs.title: Senior Researcher – Demos Digital Team
jobs.reason: The "Senior" title here signals independent project management and building senior policy networks, but the posting expressly welcomes applicants meeting only "some" of the attributes and frames experience as demonstrable rather than a fixed multi-year post-qualification bar, so it does not clearly trip the level disqualifier — the core research, literature-review and qualitative/quantitative skills fit well and the London hybrid base satisfies the location filter. The subject (mis/disinformation, foreign interference, AI and information ecosystems, epistemic security) sits squarely in zone (c) tech/OSINT-adjacent policy research, a real interest boost. Score is held down by the seniority framing (independently managing projects and nurturing senior stakeholder networks) that leans beyond a first graduate role.

jobs.title: Researcher, Special Risk Analysis
jobs.reason: "Ability to carry out research in French" is listed as an essential, and the candidate's French is only B1 (working, not research-fluent), which fails this essential requirement. Otherwise this would be a strong entry-level fit at a core zone-(b) firm with excellent research/writing alignment — but the French requirement gates it.

jobs.title: Publishing Assistant
jobs.reason: Genuinely entry-level with essential requirements the candidate meets — a Bachelor's, strong English writing, analytical ability and MS Office — and the academic-publishing environment aligns with the candidate's publication experience and interest in scholarly work. However, this is an administrative / project-support publishing role rather than research on the candidate's core mission, and the behavioral/social-sciences journals focus is only tangentially related to their international-law and security interests, which caps the interest pull.
